title: A Trip to Xi'an
subtitle: 考点：一般过去时 / Where did you go?

dialogue.t: Mike, where did you go last week?
I went to Xi'an with my family.
Wow! Did you see the Terracotta Warriors?
Yes, I did. There were thousands of clay soldiers.
We took a plane. Then we went to the museum by bus.
Yes. The warriors were amazing, and I took a lot of photos.
